Match labels to members, strictly

Source: R/aliases.R
scale_match.Rd

Resolves each label to a (frame, unit) member in two stages, stopping at the first that hits: an exact member name (case-insensitive), then an alias (case-insensitive). A label that hits several members – the same name at two frames, or an alias shared by two members – is reported as "ambiguous" with the candidates, unless frame= narrows the search to one frame. A label that hits nothing is "none". Nothing is guessed: no fuzzy matching, no substring matching.

scale_match(x, labels, frame = NULL, source = NULL)

Arguments

x

A NestedScale.

labels

Character vector of labels to resolve.

frame

Restrict matching to one frame; NULL searches all frames and the atom level.

source

Restrict the alias stage to one source (or several).

Value

A data.frame with one row per label: label, frame, unit, method ("exact", "alias", "ambiguous", "none") and candidates (the frame/unit pairs of an ambiguous hit, joined by "; ", else NA).

Examples

s <- scale_example()
scale_match(s, c("P", "G1", "u1", "nope"))   # G1 is a class AND a group
#>   label  frame unit    method         candidates
#> 1     P sector    P     exact               <NA>
#> 2    G1   <NA> <NA> ambiguous class/G1; group/G1
#> 3    u1   unit   U1     exact               <NA>
#> 4  nope   <NA> <NA>      none               <NA>
scale_match(s, "G1", frame = "group")
#>   label frame unit method candidates
#> 1    G1 group   G1  exact       <NA>
